newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samseong to sell 60,000 common shares.
newsitem.headline: Samseong to sell 60,000 common shares.

text.p: Samseong Publishing Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would sell 60,000 shares, or five percent of the company's share capital, to raise operational funds.
The company will not hold any shares of its own after the sales, a company statement said.
The shares will be sold on the open market between February 15 and May 14 at the previous day's closing price, the statement said. The sell-off will be handled through Daishin Securities.
Samseong shares closed at 24,000 won on Tuesday, up 1,000 from Monday.
